answer_1.quote: We showcase TrufLL on the task of Visual Question Generation (VQG)... Thus, TrufLL can be applied to any language generation task given a generic LM and a reward.

answer_2.quote: We also compute n-grams metrics, BLEU, METEOR and CIDEr ... we also compute the perplexity of the question given an external LM (ppl‑e) and its perplexity given the task‑related LM (ppl‑t).

answer_4.quote: On the VQAv2 task, we also performed human evaluation by surveying 53 participants on the first 50 questions produced by some of the models at test time. ... First, we evaluated the language quality ... Secondly, we evaluated language grounding ... Thirdly, we evaluated the language originality and diversity ... Finally, we evaluated the number of syntax errors.
answer_4.guideline: Pairwise comparison of question samples produced by two models, asking participants to select the better one according to each criterion.
